control_socket_name.description: Unix socket path for Kea control agent communication

lease_database_type.description:
Backend database type for lease storage (e.g., 'memfile', 'mysql', 'postgresql')
      - 'memfile': file-based lease storage
      - 'mysql': MySQL database backend
      - 'postgresql': PostgreSQL database backend

lease_database_name.description: Name of the lease database (used for SQL backends)

lease_database_user.description: Username to connect to the lease database

lease_database_password.description: Password for the lease database user

lease_database_host.description: Host address of the lease database server

lease_database_port.description: Port of the SQL lease database server (mysql/postgresql only). Unset = the backend's standard port (MySQL 3306, PostgreSQL 5432).

lease_database_lfc_interval.description: Interval (in seconds) between lease file cleanup (LFC) operations

lease_database_max_reclaim_leases.description: Maximum number of leases to reclaim during a single LFC cycle

lease_database_max_reclaim_time.description: Maximum time (in milliseconds) a single LFC cycle may take

lease_database_unwarned_reclaim_cycles.description: Number of cycles after which a warning is emitted if reclaiming is still ongoing

hooks_libraries.description: List of hook libraries to load (e.g., for logging, auditing, or custom logic)

log_output.description: Where the kea-dhcp6 logger writes: stdout, stderr, syslog, syslog:<name>, or a file path. The RPM logs to kea-dhcp6.log (relative to Kea's log directory).

log_severity.description: Lowest severity the kea-dhcp6 logger keeps.

log_debuglevel.description: Debug verbosity when log_severity is DEBUG: 0 (least) to 99 (most).
